Class TestDataFactory.TestBillSuite

public class TestDataFactory.TestBillSuite
extends TestDataFactory.TestSuite

Test suite for creating a complete bill scenario with related records including account, payments, orders, and optionally adjustments, collections, commissions, and Stripe transactions.
